title: Flight with Jake Barber over a Lockheed Martin underground facility
place_text: Desert near Burbank, California (Lockheed Martin facility)

tellings.quote: We flew over one of the Loheed Martin facilities and it was wild because it's this kind of bowlshaped thing in the ground and there's a huge hanger door. It's clearly an underground structure >> and all these white vans come racing out as we're as we're flying circling this

plain: A congressman named Eric Burlison says that around 2024 or 2025 he flew with a man named Jake Barber over a Lockheed Martin facility in the desert near Burbank, California, and saw "this kind of bowl-shaped thing in the ground" with "a huge hangar door," clearly an underground structure. He tells Michels that as they circled, "all these white vans come racing out." He tells it as something he saw himself, suggesting the site holds something guarded closely enough to rush people out at the sight of a plane.
